detail: Chose to phase the work as: verifications first → test helper → server gate → simple hook guards → ensure-claude-md-gates (compound changes) → SessionStart command hook → versions → manual smoke test → release. Foundation-first ordering means each phase's tests can rely on infrastructure from prior phases.
